Use the licensed reference car as the identity and equipment reference for a photorealistic isolated BMW X3 F25 five-door SUV from the original 2010–2014 phase. Create a new, balanced front three-quarter view, between a front one-third and front one-half view, with the nose pointing right. The grille and the long side should both be easy to see. Use one coherent camera for the whole car and keep its ordinary body proportions.

Keep this actual car’s metallic brown paint, silver window surround and two raised silver longitudinal roof rails. Keep its silver wheels with five broad double-lobed spokes, BMW wheel and bonnet roundels, body-color outward mirrors without added indicators, body-color handles, actual white fender indicator and the small silver xDrive28i model marking at its original body position. Retain the original separated headlights and kidney grille, round upper fog lamps, plain lower corner openings and silver lower bumper trim. Do not substitute a facelift or M Sport front, wheels or trim. No crossbars or roof box. The low rear roof antenna region is naturally obscured in the reference; retain only the supported low contour and occlusion. Do not invent a higher fin, hidden base or mast.

The identity to preserve is the car’s shape and equipment. The reflected scene must change: remove all recognizable buildings, window grids, fences, trees, people, neighboring cars, yellow vans, signs, lettering and street or floor reflections from its paint, glass and mirrors. Replace these scene mappings with clean, nonrecognizable soft studio highlights. Keep the actual metallic brown color and glossy clearcoat finish, with natural polished highlight transitions; do not make the paint matte, satin, black or flat. Keep a coherent quiet empty cabin. Remove temporary windshield stickers and license plate characters, retaining a plain blank plate with the original shape and blue appearance. Preserve factory badges and physical parts.

Deliver the complete car on a true transparent RGBA background. Every tire, mirror, rail and bumper corner must be fully inside the image. Leave at least 80 pixels of transparent space above and to either side, and at least 100 pixels below the tires; the car should occupy about 78 percent of the canvas width. No floor, cast shadow, contact shadow, halo, checkerboard, text, watermark or caption. Do not introduce any feature from the catalog comparison image.
